description: Supplier master (ผู้จำหน่าย): create a supplierStore, a back-office web CRUD screen, and point the stock-receive supplier picker at the store. The Supplier type already exists in src/types/inventory.ts and MOCK_SUPPLIERS exists in src/data/mockInventory.ts; stock docs already carry supplierId/supplierName and the receive form already uses a picker (not free text). Independent of the other FEATs.
steps: Create src/store/supplierStore.ts following the function-API house style of src/store/branchStore.ts: zustand create + persist, name 'pos-suppliers', storage: createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage). Seed state.suppliers from MOCK_SUPPLIERS (import from ../data/mockInventory). Export: getSuppliers(): Supplier[], getSupplier(id): Supplier | undefined, addSupplier(data: Omit<Supplier,'id'>): Supplier (id = `sup-${Date.now()}-${random}`), updateSupplier(id, updates: Partial<Omit<Supplier,'id'>>): void, deleteSupplier(id): void. Import Supplier from ../types/inventory. On each mutation call logAction('ผู้จำหน่าย', 'เพิ่ม'|'แก้ไข'|'ลบ', <Thai description with supplier name>, { supplierId }) from ../store/auditLogStore.

Create src/screens/web/WebSupplierScreen.tsx modeled closely on src/screens/web/WebBranchManageScreen.tsx (same WebColors tokens, card grid layout, inline add/edit form, window.confirm on delete, Ionicons empty state). Fields: name (required, Thai label 'ชื่อผู้จำหน่าย'), taxId ('เลขผู้เสียภาษี'), phone ('เบอร์โทร'), contactName ('ผู้ติดต่อ'). Read via supplierStore.getSuppliers(); a local refreshKey state (useState number, bump after each mutation) forces re-render as WebBranchManageScreen does. Include loading state (brief, optional), empty state ('ยังไม่มีผู้จำหน่าย'), and a guard/error alert for empty required name on save. Use Platform.OS==='web' guards only where the sibling does.

Register the screen in src/navigation/WebNavigator.tsx: add import; add case 'suppliers': return <WebSupplierScreen />; in renderContent(); add suppliers: 'ผู้จำหน่าย' to the local PAGE_NAMES map. For access gating, extend the inline includes list so 'suppliers' reuses the 'products' permission key: in navigate() set accessKey, and in the routeAccessKey computation, add 'suppliers' mapped to 'products' (mirror how 'documents'/'licenses'/'branches' map to 'settings').
Add a sidebar entry in src/components/web/WebSidebar.tsx NAV_ITEMS: { route: 'suppliers', icon: 'business-outline', label: 'ผู้จำหน่าย' } (place near products/pricing).

Wire the stock-receive picker to the store in src/screens/inventory/StockDocFormScreen.tsx: replace the MOCK_SUPPLIERS import usages — the supplierName lookup (const supplierName = ... .find) and the SimplePickerModal items for the supplier picker — to read from supplierStore.getSuppliers() instead of MOCK_SUPPLIERS. Keep the leading '— ไม่ระบุ —' option and all existing save behavior (supplierId/supplierName set on receive only). Do NOT change the free-text vs picker model (it is already a picker).

Decision (record in findings, make NO code change): do not add supplierId to ProductMaster. ProductMaster has no supplier field today; keeping supplier↔stock-doc linkage only is lower risk and avoids touching product-type/variant territory (variant matrix is out of scope).
acceptance_criteria: src/store/supplierStore.ts exists, persists under 'pos-suppliers', seeds from MOCK_SUPPLIERS, and exposes get/add/update/delete + getById with logAction on mutations.
WebSupplierScreen is reachable from the web sidebar (ผู้จำหน่าย), supports create/edit/delete with Thai labels, confirm-on-delete, and an empty state; added suppliers survive a page reload.
The รับสินค้า (stock receive) supplier picker lists suppliers from supplierStore (a newly added supplier appears there), and saving a receive doc still records supplierId/supplierName.
`npm run lint` shows no new tsc errors beyond the 13 baseline; `npm test` shows no new failures.
verification: Run `npm run lint` and confirm tsc error count <= 13 baseline with none in the new/edited files.
Run `npm test` and confirm >= 24 tests pass with no new failing suites.
Manual: open web app → ผู้จำหน่าย, add 'ทดสอบซัพพลายเออร์', reload, confirm it persists; open a รับสินค้า form and confirm the new supplier is selectable.
findings: DONE. supplierStore persists under 'pos-suppliers' (createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage)), seeds from MOCK_SUPPLIERS, exposes getSuppliers/getSupplier/addSupplier/updateSupplier/deleteSupplier with logAction('ผู้จำหน่าย', 'เพิ่ม'|'แก้ไข'|'ลบ', ...). Supplier id format = `sup-${Date.now()}-${random36(4)}`. Web route key = 'suppliers'; access key REUSES 'products' (admin always passes) — wired in 3 places: WebNavigator navigate() accessKey, WebNavigator routeAccessKey, and WebSidebar visibleItems filter (all map 'suppliers' -> 'products'; mirrors the documents/licenses/branches -> settings pattern). PAGE_NAMES['suppliers']='ผู้จำหน่าย'. Switch case 'suppliers' -> <WebSupplierScreen/>. Sidebar NAV_ITEMS entry added after 'pricing': { route:'suppliers', icon:'business-outline', label:'ผู้จำหน่าย' }. WebSupplierScreen.tsx modeled on WebBranchManageScreen (WebColors, card grid, inline add/edit form, window.confirm delete, empty state 'ยังไม่มีผู้จำหน่าย', window.alert guard on empty name). Fields name/taxId/phone/contactName. StockDocFormScreen now reads const suppliers = supplierStore.getSuppliers() for both supplierName lookup and the supplier SimplePickerModal items (kept leading '— ไม่ระบุ —'); save behavior unchanged (supplierId/supplierName set on receive only). MOCK_SUPPLIERS import left in StockDocFormScreen because an unrelated dead placeholder line (const stockItem = MOCK_SUPPLIERS in handleScan) still references it — out of scope, not touched. DECISION: did NOT add supplierId to ProductMaster (no supplier field on ProductMaster today; supplier<->stock-doc linkage only is lower risk and avoids product-type/variant territory). VERIFY: npm run lint = 13 tsc errors (== baseline, 0 in new/edited files); npm test = 24 passed, same 3 pre-existing suites fail to load (engine/SyncService/branchPermissionStore). No new failures.
